title: RAFM-SER++: A Lightweight Multimodal Emotion Recognition Framework for Real-Time Behavioral Monitoring in Surveillance Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.07409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent multimodal Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) systems achieve high accuracy through interaction-heavy cross-modal transformers, but their computational cost limits deployment in latency-sensitive and resource-constrained surveillance systems. To address this challenge, we propose RAFM_SER++, a lightweight multimodal SER framework featuring an asymmetric Residual Attention Fusion Mechanism (RAFM). Rather than relying on computationally expensive bidirectional interactions, RAFM injects affective speech cues into semantic text representations through a one-directional residual attention pathway. Combined with a BYOL-inspired cross-modal alignment objective and attention-guided pooling, the proposed framework improves multimodal representation learning while maintaining low computational overhead. translated_abstract: 近期多模态语音情感识别（SER）系统通过交互密集的跨模态Transformer实现了高精度，但其高昂的计算成本限制了在延迟敏感且资源受限的监控系统中的部署。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了RAFM_SER++，这是一种轻量级的多模态SER框架，其核心特点是采用非对称残差注意力融合机制（RAFM）。RAFM不依赖计算开销高昂的双向交互，而是通过单向残差注意力通路将语音中的情感线索注入语义文本表示中。结合受BYOL启发的跨模态对齐目标和注意力引导池化，所提出的框架在保持低计算开销的同时改善了多模态表示学习。在IEMOCAP和ESD基准数据集上的实验表明，RAFM_SER++始终优于HuBERT-Base基线，并取得了……
tldr: 提出了一种轻量级多模态语音情感识别框架RAFM_SER++，通过非对称单向残差注意力融合机制在低计算开销下实现高性能情感识别，适用于资源受限的实时监控系统。
en_tdlr: RAFM-SER++ is a lightweight multimodal speech emotion recognition framework that leverages an asymmetric one-directional residual attention fusion mechanism to achieve superior performance with low computational overhead, enabling real-time behavioral monitoring in resource-constrained surveillance systems.
